digest.component_or_area: plan-review and code-review documentation and CLI
propositions: Authors and contributors lack a concise, discoverable on-ramp for how to write a plan that passes the plan-review gate; existing material is either gate-mechanics focused or a reviewer-facing criterion registry
The code-review gate (LLM-Review + Verified) has the same discoverability gap for authors as the plan-review gate
AGENTS.md incorrectly points authors at the generated criterion registry for the description template instead of author-facing guidance
The CLI `rebar explain` command must be extended to support author-guide names (plan, review) in addition to criterion IDs via a shared registry lookup
New prose on-ramp docs must remain distinct from the generated criterion registry to preserve the registry as the single source of truth for reviewers while providing author-focused guidance
The docs-index CI gate requires all top-level docs/*.md files to be linked from docs/README.md
